title: HB 4805 (2015-2016 Regular Session, Michigan Legislature (bill page title: "House Bill 4805 of 2015")): Elections; polling places; public notification related to signing an affidavit for voters without a valid photo identification card; require. Amends sec. 668a of 1954 PA 116 (MCL 168.668a ).
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id)
(section) Sec. 668a (as in the version read)
(quote) (c) Information on an individual's right to sign an affidavit before an election inspector and be allowed to obtain and vote a ballot if the individual does not have an official state personal identification card, operator's or chauffeur's license, or other generally recognized picture identification card to identify himself or herself as required to obtain and vote a ballot.
(section) Sec. 668a (as in the version read)
(quote) (e) Information on the identification requirements that apply to voters who register by mail.
(b_no_id_remedy) not stated.
(c_mail_ballot_id) not stated.
(d_proof_of_citizenship) not stated.
(e_other_rule) not stated.
(other) Only the section(s) quoted above are amended; no other subject.
(note) Off this topic: the bill sets no ID or citizenship-proof rule.
